Show the difference between a list comprehension and a generator expression.

Supplied answer
squares_list = [x ** 2 for x in range(5)] # list, uses memory now
squares_gen = (x ** 2 for x in range(5)) # generator, lazy
print(squares_list) # [0, 1, 4, 9, 16]
print(squares_gen) # <generator object ...>
print(list(squares_gen)) # [0, 1, 4, 9, 16]
print(list(squares_gen)) # [] -> already used up
Note: Square brackets build a list; round brackets build a generator that can be used only once.
